meta.title: Poland Constitutional Tribunal judges: relationship and money map

confidence_levels.fact: stated by a primary record or a reputable source; not seriously disputed
confidence_levels.alleged: a named party (prosecutor, politician, outlet) claims it; not proven
confidence_levels.speculation: our own inference or a plausible pattern; no source states it
confidence_levels.unproven_conspiracy: circulating theory with no supporting evidence, or contradicted by a court/record

notes: No source shows money from wind investors to any of the 8 judges.
Shared Gdansk roots/university among Tusk, Nawrocki and Berek are not treated as edges.
People are linked only by institutional, financial or organisational ties, never by ethnicity or religion.
2026-10-31 correction: 'no_link' covers only direct payments. Indirect organisational ties (judge -> OSF-funded org) are 'fact' edges with tie='indirect' and via=<org>.
oped_flags: Op-ed calls the judge 'Krystyna' Korwin-Piotrowska; every source says Anna.
Op-ed calls Patyra 'Stanisław'; his name is Sławomir.
'the group Tusk led as party president': Tusk led the EPP party (2019-22), not the EP group (led by Weber).
'Soros's Polish foundation': Batory was founded by Soros in 1988 and lists OSF as a donor, but is an independent Polish foundation; 'Soros-founded' is accurate.
'Civic Coalition MEP': elected on the KO list but non-party; EP profile says 'Independent'.
'Free Courts has published no statement': we only know its website news stops in 2024; say 'none found on its website'.
'precise plan' quote comes from TVP's page summary only; full interview not retrieved.

'An American-funded fellow co-founded a group that took Soros money': he co-founded Free Courts in 2017, years before the NED fellowship (2022/23) and the OSF grant (2023-24); the wording implies a sequence that did not happen.
'Two other new judges advised Soros's Polish foundation': they co-signed a Batory expert-team position; 'advised' is fair, payment undisclosed.
US 'They said it out loud' section: all real quotes, but none is tied to Poland in any source; the graph marks the Poland link no_link.

tie_field.direct: money or role straight from funder to person
tie_field.indirect: person has a role in an organisation the funder pays; field 'via' names it

nodes.label: Anna Korwin-Piotrowska

No private practice, firm, client, company, board or grant found. 2026 declaration (as of 9 Apr 2026): savings PLN 132,774.70 + EUR 29,190.95 + USD 6,000; the same house and flat plus an undeveloped plot. 2025 declaration side income: PLN 13,360 from MoJ exam commissions, PLN 1,800 from the Opole Bar, PLN 280 from the Opole legal advisers' chamber; cars Hyundai Tucson (2017) and Alfa Romeo MiTo (2018)
nodes.family: Married (property held in marital community per her 2025 declaration); spouse not named in any source. No documented family tie to journalist Karolina Korwin-Piotrowska or politician Janusz Korwin-Mikke
nodes.tk_oath: Took oath in the Sejm before a notary on 9 Apr 2026; refused to resign her Opole judgeship (Apr 2026)

leads.label: unproven_conspiracy

leads.lead: TK judges' China trip
leads.result: 2015 trip under earlier court; none of current 8
leads.label: no_link

leads.lead: Themis is the Żurek network inside the TK
leads.result: fact that Żurek co-founded Themis and she leads it; Bodnar is an honorary member and appointed her Opole president; that this tie drove 30 Oct is not documented
leads.label: speculation

leads.lead: Foreign money reached her through MEDEL
leads.result: Themis joined MEDEL in 2023; MEDEL names no funders; no payment to Themis or her found
leads.label: no_link

leads.lead: Paid by Żurek's ministry while a TK judge
leads.result: yes, ~PLN 7k exam-commission fee under his 17 Feb 2026 ordinance; experts call it a conflict of interest
leads.label: fact

leads.lead: 'Energy for Europe' is a wind/energy lobby paying Wawrykiewicz
leads.result: No. It is a Warsaw civic-education foundation (KRS 0000409053) whose name is the only energy element. It paid him EUR 295 for lecturing in 2022. Its 2013 programme council included figures from the conservative camp (e.g. Marek A. Cichocki, Stanisław Kluza, Jan Ołdakowski) and it ran a 2016-17 Baptism-of-Poland schools project, so it is not an obvious liberal or KO-aligned body (our reading, not sourced as such).
leads.label: no_link

leads.lead: Tomasz E. Siemiątkowski on FEdE's supervisory body is the ex-intelligence chief
leads.result: Not the same name: the former UOP/AW head is Zbigniew Siemiątkowski. No identity link.
leads.label: no_link

leads.lead: Wyborcza pays Wawrykiewicz / Soros pays via Wyborcza
leads.result: Wyborcza paid him EUR 189 a year for articles (2021-23). Its publisher Agora is controlled by the founders' Agora-Holding (35.36% of votes); OSF-funded MDIF holds 8.41% of votes and OSF's Polish-media money went to MDIF start-up programmes. Indirect OSF tie is fact; OSF control of Wyborcza is unproven.
leads.label: fact

leads.lead: Judges write for Wyborcza
leads.result: Not checked in this pass; bylines of the 8 judges in Wyborcza not searched.
leads.label: speculation

leads.lead: Batory paid Taborowski and Patyra for expert-team work
leads.result: No fee, honorarium or budget line found in the team's documents or 2023-25 annual reports; payment simply undisclosed
leads.label: no_link

leads.lead: The two judges drafted the TK law they now apply
leads.result: Fact that their team drafted the 2024 TK bills; their personal drafting role is not documented (only Zalasiński named)
leads.label: speculation

leads.lead: PGE seat was a reward for the Barski opinion
leads.result: Timing fits (opinion published 12 Jan 2024, PGE seat from 1 Feb 2024) and Bodnar's ministry used the opinion; the reward claim is only made by niezalezna.pl
leads.label: alleged

leads.lead: Taborowski is Bodnar's man
leads.result: Fact: he was Deputy Ombudsman under Bodnar from May 2019 and argued RPO cases at the CJEU; nothing documents coordination with Bodnar as minister
leads.label: speculation

leads.lead: Taborowski's law firm has state or foreign clients
leads.result: Sejm written question 3200 mentions the firm but its text could not be retrieved; firm revenue is paywalled. Open lead
leads.label: speculation

leads.lead: Taborowski still practises law while a TK judge
leads.result: Bar register still lists him as practising; registers often lag and he is not yet recognised as a judge by the TK leadership. No evidence of current practice
leads.label: speculation

leads.lead: Expert-team network = Bodnar/Batory circle around both judges
leads.result: Fact edges: Rakowska (Batory team) co-wrote the Barski opinions with Patyra; Machińska (Bodnar deputy with Taborowski) sits on Batory's council; Matczak in team and council
leads.label: fact

leads.lead: EU money replaced US money for Batory
leads.result: 2025 report adds EU CERV (EUR 6.7m Equal Rights Programme) and Batory leads the EUR 83.5m EEA fund for 2025-31; OSF still listed as donor
leads.label: fact
